audit.whatIsWrong: diff said EVEN at 5.5/10 and the TL;DR claimed a poke mirror Mel usually wins.
audit.why: Mel is 44.54% over 238 Emerald+ games, and both the level chart and the content layer already give Kennen 4 of 7 stages. The full layer contradicted its own chart.
audit.corrected: diff HARD, diffRating 7/10, TL;DR rewritten to a losing poke war that evens out late.

audit.why: Spikes are correctly placed: Kennen takes over at 6 with Slicing Maelstrom (120s flat) plus a third Mark, and again on his first AP item; Mel evens the poke war late once Overwhelm stacking and Rebuttal matter.
audit.corrected: Left the spike structure; added the real 120s Slicing Maelstrom cooldown to the cooldown breakdown so the survive-it-once advice is concrete.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two false interactions. The full layer told the player to "Reflect Lightning Rush back the moment he commits" and built the whole focus/loading/cooldown framing around Lightning Rush. The content layer said Rebuttal eats "Shuriken and Surge" and reflects both.
audit.why: Rebuttal reflects projectiles. Per Riot text, only Thundering Shuriken (Q) is a projectile in Kennen kit — Lightning Rush (E) is a movement form that passes through units, Electrical Surge (W) is an on-hit/activated effect on already-marked targets, and Slicing Maelstrom (R) is a zone. None of the three can be reflected. Reflecting Lightning Rush is not a play that exists.
audit.corrected: Rebuttal is stated as reflecting Thundering Shuriken only, with Lightning Rush and Electrical Surge named as passing through. Focus retargeted from Lightning Rush to Mark of the Storm, the actual threat, since the three-stack stun is what kills Mel.

audit.whatIsWrong: tradeBad and dontsFull[2].d both said Rebuttal is "gone for twenty seconds".
audit.why: Rebuttal is 38/35/33/29/26s. Twenty seconds is shorter than the ability ever gets, so the advice understated the risk at exactly the rank the player has it in lane.
audit.corrected: 38s at rank 1, and the threat repointed from Lightning Rush range to Slicing Maelstrom range.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing anywhere told the player that Electrical Surge applies its Mark through autos as an on-hit effect.
audit.why: The _missing file flags exactly this: Kennen applies on-hit through Electrical Surge, so his stack rate scales with attack speed, not just with spell casts. A Mel player dodging Q and holding W still eats the third Mark from autos.
audit.corrected: wants.you[1] and the late block now name Electrical Surge as on-hit and unreflectable.
